title: kashti hamari paar lagaana
body:
imaame zamana a.s
kashti hamari paar lagana
imaame zamana a.s
ghulaamou ko apne bhool na jana
imaame zamana a.s
nigaahe karam ham pe aaqa tumhari
umeede liye aaye dar par tumari
mayoos ham ko na moula phiraana
<<DIVIDER>>
mushkil kusha ibne mushkil kusha ho
haajat ho puri haajat rawa ho
moula hamari bigdi banaana
<<DIVIDER>>
godi me jinki nahi koi bachha
ata kardo unko asghar ka sadqa
godi sabhi ki moula sajaana
<<DIVIDER>>
kab se ye daaman pasaare hue hai
gham to hamesha hamare hue hai
khushio ka moula dedo qazaana
<<DIVIDER>>
ada kardo qarze ghaib se moula
kisi ka na mohtaaj rakhna qudara
izzat se hum sab ko moula jilana
<<DIVIDER>>
jo bekaar hai unko rozi dilado
jo soye muqaddar hai unko jagaado
rozi se hum sab ko moula lagana
<<DIVIDER>>
jo beemaar hai unko shifa dedo moula
sadqaye shahe huda dedo moula
mareezou ko bistar se moula uthaana
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhe waasta moula hai panjetan ka
wo karbobala ke bhai behan ka
rahe shaado abaad sabhi ka gharana
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhe waasta moula rasoole zaman ka
wo karbobala ke ghuncha dahan ka
ghame ehlebait ham se kabhi na bhulaana
<<DIVIDER>>
ziyarat ka shouq moula dil me hamare
ghulaam apko moula dil se pukaare
wo din aaye moula karbala bulana
